overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: no draft minutes existed on the February 8 request date, and the committee offered to send them once completed. Two other allegations were declined.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the committee failed to make draft minutes of a February 9 meeting available within 10 days of his February 8 request.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the Open Meeting Law would not have required the Committee to produce any draft minutes in response to this request, as none existed on the date of the request, February 8.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the committee did not allow public participation during the February 9 meeting; the AG declined to review because the OML leaves this to the chair.
allegations.key_passage: To the extent that Mr. Swinson alleges that the Committee did not allow public participation during the February 9 meeting, we decline to review this allegation.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the committee failed to produce a recording of the February 9 meeting in response to his request; the AG declined as a Public Records Law matter.
allegations.key_passage: Because this allegation would be governed by the Public Records Law, we decline to review this allegation.
